title: Count characters
description:
Count each kind of character in a line using a table in memory.

```
Text: Hello, World 42!
letters 10, digits 2, spaces 2, other 2
most common letter: l (3)
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
ask:    db      "Text: ", 0

        section .bss
line:   resb    128
counts: resd    26

        section .text
_start:
        lea     rdi, [rel ask]
        call    print_str
        lea     rdi, [rel line]
        mov     esi, 128
        call    read_line
        ; TODO

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `or al, 0x20` lower-cases an ASCII letter; then `sub al, 'a'` gives the table index and `inc dword [rcx + rax*4]` counts it (lesson 4.02).
`.bss` starts as zeros, so the table needs no clearing.
requirements: A 26-entry `resd` table counts each letter (ignoring case).
Classify each byte with comparisons; keep the totals in registers.
Find the most common letter with a second loop over the table.
stretch: Print a little bar chart of the letters that appear.
